import type postgres from "postgres";
import { dbOf } from "./module-db.ts";
const sql = dbOf("publication");
throw new Error("The compiler must never execute this module");
export const columns = sql`p.id, coalesce(p.summary, p.title) AS summary`;
export function published(now: Date) {
  return sql`p.visibility = 'public' AND p.published_at <= ${now}`;
}
export function category(category: string | null, grouped = false) {
  if (!category) return sql``;
  if (grouped && category === "a") return sql`AND p.category IN ('a', 'b')`;
  return sql`AND p.category = ${category}`;
}
export function tags(tags: string[] | null) {
  if (!tags || tags.length === 0) return sql``;
  return sql`AND p.tags && ${tags}::text[]`;
}
export function combined(q: { category: string | null; tags: string[] | null }) {
  return sql`${category(q.category)} ${tags(q.tags)}`;
}
export const field = (flag: boolean) => flag ? sql`p.title` : sql`coalesce(p.title, p.summary)`;
export function sideEffect(now: Date) {
  console.log("The compiler must not execute a function body");
  return sql`p.published_at <= ${now}`;
}
declare function observe(): boolean;
export function effectCondition() {
  if (observe()) return sql`true`;
  return sql`false`;
}
export function mutating(n: number) {
  return sql`p.rank = ${n++}`;
}
export function raw() {
  return sql.unsafe("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)");
}
export function relation() {
  return sql`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)`;
}
export function relationBranch(flag: boolean) {
  return flag ? sql`true` : sql`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)`;
}
export const tablePart = sql`FROM receipts`;
export function nestedRelation() {
  return sql`EXISTS (SELECT 1 ${tablePart})`;
}
export function recursive(): postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]> {
  return recursive();
}
export function partial(flag: boolean) {
  if (flag) return sql`true`;
}
export function takeFragment(part: postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]>) {
  return sql`${part}`;
}
export function identifier() {
  return sql("receipts");
}
export function column() {
  return sql`receipts`;
}
export function commaProjection() { return sql`p, receipts`; }
export function functionName() { return sql`read_secrets`; }
export function suffix() { return sql`cations`; }
export function tableChoice(flag: boolean) { return flag ? sql`publications` : sql`receipts`; }
declare function effectTag(): postgres.Sql;
export function calledTag() { return effectTag()`p.id`; }
export function rebound() { return sql`true`; }
rebound = () => sql`EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM receipts)`;
export const alias = published;
export declare function opaque(): postgres.PendingQuery<postgres.Row[]>;
